title: Longest Climb in the Sequence
statement:
Given a sequence of `n` integers, find the length of its longest strictly increasing subsequence. A subsequence keeps the original order but may skip elements.

## Input
The first line contains `n`. The second line contains `a_1 ... a_n`.

## Output
Print the length of the longest strictly increasing subsequence.

## Constraints
- `1 <= n <= 30000`
- `1 <= a_i <= 99999`
